text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer. Thanks for the day off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
By the way, got a sec? I found the most 
hype MV yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd like this sort of thing 
too. Mind if I play it right here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City seems to have fully refreshed 
herself over the day off.
